title.en: Independent free trials and expert-ordered vocabulary
title.zh: 独立免费试学与专业词汇学习顺序

purpose.en: Give anonymous learners a language-first free trial with five independent skill pages, and make every course vocabulary journey progress in 20-word rounds ordered from easier and more frequently used words.
purpose.zh: 为匿名学习者提供先选语言、再进入五个独立技能页面的免费试学，并让所有课程词汇按由易到难、由常用到较少用的顺序，以每轮 20 词完成学习。

en: Open Free Trial from Play as a 12-language picker with all five skills initially unselected.
Open vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking on separate anonymous pages whose URLs contain the beginner course ID.
Show 20 vocabulary words per library page and let learners start a 20-word round from any listed word.
Run each vocabulary word through SmartCard answer, three automatic pronunciation analyses, and sentence assembly.
Show a 20-word summary dialog with Continue and Not now choices.
zh: 从边玩边学打开免费试学，先选择十二种语言之一，五项技能默认全部未选。
词汇、阅读、写作、听力和口语分别进入独立匿名页面，网址包含初级课程编号。
词汇列表每页显示 20 个词，点击任意词即可从该词开始一轮 20 词学习。
每个词依次完成智慧卡答题、三遍自动发音分析和句子组句。
每轮 20 词结束后弹出总结，并可选择继续或暂不继续。

en: Anonymous Free Trial
Course vocabulary library
SmartCard practice
Pronunciation and sentence practice
Administrator Project report
zh: 匿名免费试学
课程词汇列表
智慧卡练习
发音与组句练习
管理员 Project 报告

en: Add a reusable Free Trial language and skill picker plus course-specific trial routes.
Add frequency degree 1–10 to all 48,000 published vocabulary records while preserving expert difficulty 1–5.
Order each course by difficulty ascending and frequency descending.
Return 20-word server rounds, including a learner-selected starting word.
Display difficulty and frequency on card backs and vocabulary-list entries.
zh: 新增可复用的免费试学语言与技能选择器，以及课程专属试学路由。
为全部 48,000 条已发布词汇增加 1–10 常用度，同时保留专业难度 1–5。
每门课程先按难度升序、再按常用度降序排列。
服务器每次返回 20 词，并支持学习者指定起始词。
在词卡背面和词汇列表中显示难度与常用度。

en: Run TypeScript, all 328 repository tests, the verified production build, sensitive-data scan, and artifact validation.
Verify the 48,000-row migration has valid 1–5 difficulty and 1–10 frequency values.
Use real Chrome and Safari to complete the language picker, independent skill route, vocabulary start point, card back, and 20-word flow.
zh: 执行 TypeScript、全部 328 项仓库测试、正式构建、敏感数据扫描和产物验证。
验证 48,000 条词汇迁移后的难度均为 1–5、常用度均为 1–10。
使用真实 Chrome 与 Safari 完整验证语言选择、独立技能路由、词汇起点、词卡背面和 20 词流程。

en: Real pronunciation scores require microphone speech; browsers without speech recognition report that limitation rather than fabricate a score.
zh: 真实发音评分需要麦克风语音；不支持语音识别的浏览器会明确提示限制，不会伪造分数。

en: This release is specific to SmartLingo learning data and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 本次发布仅涉及 SmartLingo 学习数据与体验，不改变其他站点。
